newsitem.title: GREECE: XIOSINVEST INTL EQUITY FUND DELIVERS STRONG RETURN.
newsitem.headline: XIOSINVEST INTL EQUITY FUND DELIVERS STRONG RETURN.

text.p: Xiosinvest international growth fund ranked first in its class with a year-to-date return of 12.26 percent in drachmas or 13.20 percent in ecus, private Xiosbank said in a statement.
Its likely yearly return will be 19 percent, it said.

The fund invests in European bourses and is directed at investors with a long-term investment horizon, interested at hedging foreign exchange risk and a higher return than provided by savings accounts in foreign currencies, it said.
Xiosinvest's portfolio was invested 93 percent in stocks and 7.0 percent in cash on August 30.
Goldman Sachs is its investment advisor, it said. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
